scenes: What does a heatwave mean for a pregnancy?
A pregnant body already runs warm and works harder. | In heat, it has less room to cool down.
Across many studies, each one degree rise raised the odds of a preterm birth by about five per cent. | During a heatwave, by about sixteen per cent.
Rest, water and shade are care, not comfort, | especially for women who keep working or fetching water while pregnant.
